title: Establish Java gateway modernization baseline
description: Document current gateway architecture, dependencies, runtime constraints, and operational baseline to prepare for Azure modernization.
requirements: Inventory runtime, dependencies, external integrations, configuration model, and baseline build/test behavior for migration planning.

title: Transform gateway integration points for Azure
description: Update application configuration and integration boundaries so the Java gateway can align with Azure-native service endpoints and cloud configuration patterns.
requirements: Externalize configuration, parameterize endpoints/secrets access, and adapt service integration abstractions required for Azure-targeted operation.

title: Run security remediation and compliance hardening
description: Perform CVE-focused dependency remediation and harden configuration/secrets handling for secure Azure operation.
requirements: Scan dependencies for CVEs, remediate findings, enforce secure secret management using Azure Key Vault patterns, and validate RBAC/security defaults.

title: Deploy modernized gateway to Azure Container Apps
description: Build and deploy the modernized Java gateway to Azure Container Apps with rollout validation and rollback readiness.
requirements: Containerize/build release artifact, deploy to Azure Container Apps, configure runtime settings and health checks, and validate smoke-level deployment behavior.
